column1: # Sample sheet template. Copy it before filling it in, then point the pipeline at your copy:
# One row per sample, columns separated by TABs. Lines starting with # are ignored.
#   sample     short unique name, letters/digits/underscore/dash only (used in file names)
#   condition  the group the sample belongs to; exactly two different values. The value set as
#              REFERENCE_LEVEL in config/config.sh (default: untreated) is the baseline
#   batch      pairing or batch factor, e.g. donor, cell line, sequencing run. It is added to the
#              model (~ batch + condition). Write - in every row if there is none
#   fastq_1    read 1: a local path (.fastq or .fastq.gz) or an http(s)/ftp URL
#   fastq_2    read 2 for paired-end data; write - for single-end data
# The placeholder rows below are paired-end. Use one layout (paired or single) for all samples.
# The reference genome is human (GRCh38); other species need other URLs in config/config.sh.
